energy normal one step before collision
heavy body reverses and gains ~7x speed across the collision step (from 6.4 to 45.2 m/s)

counterfactual.change: changed only body 1 mass from 1 to 16.315675979687114 (equal masses); collision then dissipates energy (E0 12378 -> 7200 J) and no rule is violated, showing the mass-ratio handling causes the energy injection

explanation: Oblique heavy-light circle-circle collision injects energy. At step 5 bodies are separate with normal energy ~1509 J; at step 6 they are just touching (gap 0.0018) but heavy body 0 (16.3 kg) jumped from vx -6.4 to +43.7 m/s and system energy to 17706 J with zero controller work. X-momentum jumps from ~-76 to ~+738 kg m/s, so the impulse/positional correction massively over-impulses. Setting e=0 still violates (8699 J), ruling out restitution, while equal masses passes, pointing to inverted/swapped mass weighting in the impulse (effective mass) for large mass ratios combined with deep penetration in one substepped step.
vision_note: Two circles drift toward each other across steps 3 to 5 and just touch in step 6. No large positional jump, explosion, walls, waypoints, or color change is visible in these frames.
